core_execution_audit.scope: successful Core submissions on the persistent online-serving kernel; excludes planner previews, isolated replay and pre-serving initialization
core_execution_audit.method: instrumented DramCore/NandCore submit and submit_many, selected by live PhysicalRuntimeContext identity

rows.measurement_window: earliest request arrival through simulation end, including initialization wait

measurement_windows.semantics: primary rates span earliest request arrival through simulation end; TTFT/E2E start at each request arrival; runtime rates exclude initialization

prefill.semantics: wall rate uses completed requests' input tokens once for prefill and committed non-prefill output tokens for decode; both use the primary request window. Busy rate includes scheduled/recomputed work; mixed batches overlap and busy rates are not additive

active_service_lane_imbalance.semantics: busy-time imbalance among observed effective service lanes; not a physical-plane measurement and not all configured idle lanes

unavailable.physical_plane_imbalance: detailed physical-plane observations not enabled; effective lanes are distinct
unavailable.read_queue_depth: page-level queue occupancy timeline not recorded
unavailable.program_queue_depth: page-level queue occupancy timeline not recorded

memory_metrics.semantics: GB/s equals bytes/ns; logical/media ratios include RMW and merging and must not be called physical page fill fractions

migration_ledger.scope: physical KV pool transfers, separate from operator NAND traffic; explicit endpoints and completion times

prefetch.semantics: fraction of completed lookahead bytes consumed by resumed requests; not learned-router prediction accuracy

prefetch_overlap.scope: intersection with realized GPU operator stages of other requests; host setup and GPU frontend/controller stages excluded; operator envelopes may include memory stalls, not tensor-core busy time

rows.quantile_scope: empirical interpolation over reported sample count; no population tail-latency guarantee

address_assumptions.embedding: No token-ID trace is supplied. Analytical remote embedding row traffic uses a bounded cyclic address model when reads exceed the resident table; repeated traffic is retained and the allocation is not enlarged. This is not a measured token locality trace.

kv.prefetch_metric_semantics: useful bytes are completed copies exposed to a successful consumer cohort; unused bytes include reclaimed copies and completed copies not consumed; transfer time sums per-page latency and is not GPU stall time; opt-in lifecycle cancellation drains submitted physical phases, preserves their cost, then frees the destination; cancelled bytes are separate from completed/unused bytes
modeling_limits: offload_ratio bounds pressure-triggered migratable capacity; it is not a per-token mirror ratio
prefetch disabled when prefetch_distance=0
logical KV traffic counters are not added to resource-accounted bytes when attention kernels already include local memory traffic
KV read means external persisted-cache access only; prefill/recompute historical-prompt attention remains modeled as causal compute and ordinary attention/activation traffic

dram_traffic.accounting_semantics: resolved analytical burst bytes and controller waits; null means not fully recorded; empty organization_profiles is not evidence of complete geometry reporting; no device accuracy claim

core_execution_audit.scope: successful Core submissions on the persistent online-serving kernel; excludes planner previews, isolated replay and pre-serving initialization
core_execution_audit.method: instrumented DramCore/NandCore submit and submit_many, selected by live PhysicalRuntimeContext identity
limitations: Cohort phase attribution follows actual execution; mixed cohorts are not split artificially.
Physical bytes are Core result counters; NAND internal/host transfer bytes are separate from media read/program bytes.
Instrumenting these process-global entry points requires one simulation thread per process.

rows.measurement_window: earliest request arrival through simulation end, including initialization wait

measurement_windows.semantics: primary rates span earliest request arrival through simulation end; TTFT/E2E start at each request arrival; runtime rates exclude initialization

prefill.semantics: wall rate uses completed requests' input tokens once for prefill and committed non-prefill output tokens for decode; both use the primary request window. Busy rate includes scheduled/recomputed work; mixed batches overlap and busy rates are not additive

decode.semantics: wall rate uses completed requests' input tokens once for prefill and committed non-prefill output tokens for decode; both use the primary request window. Busy rate includes scheduled/recomputed work; mixed batches overlap and busy rates are not additive

memory_metrics.scope: operator NAND traffic (HBF/SSD); separately reported KV migration traffic is not implicitly included

active_service_lane_imbalance.semantics: busy-time imbalance among observed effective service lanes; not a physical-plane measurement and not all configured idle lanes

unavailable.physical_plane_imbalance: detailed physical-plane observations not enabled; effective lanes are distinct
unavailable.read_queue_depth: page-level queue occupancy timeline not recorded
unavailable.program_queue_depth: page-level queue occupancy timeline not recorded

memory_metrics.semantics: GB/s equals bytes/ns; logical/media ratios include RMW and merging and must not be called physical page fill fractions

migration_ledger.scope: physical KV pool transfers, separate from operator NAND traffic; explicit endpoints and completion times

prefetch.semantics: fraction of completed lookahead bytes consumed by resumed requests; not learned-router prediction accuracy

prefetch_overlap.scope: intersection with realized GPU operator stages of other requests; host setup and GPU frontend/controller stages excluded; operator envelopes may include memory stalls, not tensor-core busy time

rows.quantile_scope: empirical interpolation over reported sample count; no population tail-latency guarantee

address_assumptions.embedding: No token-ID trace is supplied. Analytical remote embedding row traffic uses a bounded cyclic address model when reads exceed the resident table; repeated traffic is retained and the allocation is not enlarged. This is not a measured token locality trace.

kv.prefetch_metric_semantics: useful bytes are completed copies exposed to a successful consumer cohort; unused bytes include reclaimed copies and completed copies not consumed; transfer time sums per-page latency and is not GPU stall time; opt-in lifecycle cancellation drains submitted physical phases, preserves their cost, then frees the destination; cancelled bytes are separate from completed/unused bytes
modeling_limits: offload_ratio bounds pressure-triggered migratable capacity; it is not a per-token mirror ratio
prefetch disabled when prefetch_distance=0
logical KV traffic counters are not added to resource-accounted bytes when attention kernels already include local memory traffic
KV read means external persisted-cache access only; prefill/recompute historical-prompt attention remains modeled as causal compute and ordinary attention/activation traffic

dram_traffic.accounting_semantics: resolved analytical burst bytes and controller waits; null means not fully recorded; empty organization_profiles is not evidence of complete geometry reporting; no device accuracy claim

supported: 真实物理页读取、append、pause/resume迁移与前缀引用共享
容量受限A/B/C会话数和恢复等待对比
unsupported: 商用硬件session/GPU或论文容量倍数复现

limitations: Memory/session microbenchmark: no transformer operators, GPU execution or LLM TPS/TTFT/TPOT/goodput claims.
B explicitly assumes memory-accessible HBF and executes active reads and appends there; C migrates private cold pages and keeps shared immutable prefixes hot.
Small synthetic pages and one GPU-equivalent pool; no production session capacity claim or paper result reproduction.
Sequential admission and page transfers; requested lifecycle timestamps are identical for A/B/C but observed pause duration includes queueing and cohort scheduling.

The prefix scan offers 20 sessions at 0/25/50/90% exact requested reuse; offered and admitted denominators are reported separately. The initial prefix-producing session is in the offered denominator and does not itself count as a reuse hit.
No GC, endurance or monetary cost model is enabled in this lifecycle group.

rows.gc_model: analytical page-relocation read/program overlay evenly spread across four parallel units; no FTL state

supported: 固定逻辑写入量下的页合并、host ack/media drain 分离和满缓冲阻塞
逻辑流量、host link 流量与介质 page program 流量的分离统计
unsupported: GC/FTL 状态机和真实 GC 写放大长尾未实现；1/3/10/30 倍只作额外介质页搬运读写分析叠加
TPS、TTFT 不适用于该介质微基准

limitations: 使用生产 NandCore 的简化页合并/缓冲模型，不推断真实控制器 GC 长尾。
rows 保留所有扫描组合，不把最快或最佳行当作组结论。
页大小变化时逻辑写量、append大小与缓冲字节数保持不变；缓冲为0/16/32/64KiB，容量按host payload而非整页计费。
observed_metrics只来自实际append与排空；gc_assumed字段为分析假设，不冒充已执行GC。
1.5MiB在本组作为附件要求的大页假设，实际设置NandCore物理read/program页大小；这不是厂商NAND页规格或已校准硬件声明。
1.5MiB页大于固定128KiB逻辑工作量，因此所有写入都是部分页写入；计入完整大页的读改写成本，不能把它解读为吞吐率优势。
05组的物理页大小与06组的迁移payload独立；06组即使迁移块为1.5MiB，其NAND物理页仍是16KiB。

supported: HBF保持8倍归一化单槽容量时，全部五种HBM/HBF配比的可运行性与实际内存服务代价
容量不足行及不可运行原因
unsupported: 真实封装、面积和商业产品校准
商用最优比例、完整GPU吞吐、成本或热约束下的配置选择
TPS、TTFT 不适用于预算微基准

limitations: Default capacities are normalized pages: four per HBM slot and 32 per HBF slot (8x). They are hypothetical, not commercial package capacities or an area scaling law.
Every row has four assumed interchangeable slots. Capacity, peak directional bandwidth, parallel service lanes and HBF buffering change together with the selected mix.
HBM-first placement is striped across slots of each tier; weights precede KV. This is one explicit policy, not an optimized placement search.
The same resident set is read at every step and its final two KV pages are updated. The experiment does not grow the resident set or execute transformer operators.
Independent per-slot memory interfaces are priced by production DRAM/NAND cores. No shared GPU interconnect, compute, monetary or area budget is modeled.
An infeasible all-HBM point demonstrates this normalized capacity limit; it does not define an infinite speedup or establish a commercial HBM/HBF optimum.

core_execution_audit.scope: successful Core submissions on the persistent online-serving kernel; excludes planner previews, isolated replay and pre-serving initialization

migration_ledger.scope: physical KV pool transfers, separate from operator NAND traffic; explicit endpoints and completion times

prefetch.semantics: fraction of completed lookahead bytes consumed by resumed requests; not learned-router prediction accuracy

prefetch_overlap.scope: intersection with realized GPU operator stages of other requests; host setup and GPU frontend/controller stages excluded; operator envelopes may include memory stalls, not tensor-core busy time

rows.quantile_scope: empirical interpolation over reported sample count; no population tail-latency guarantee

modeling_limits: offload_ratio bounds pressure-triggered migratable capacity; it is not a per-token mirror ratio
prefetch disabled when prefetch_distance=0
logical KV traffic counters are not added to resource-accounted bytes when attention kernels already include local memory traffic

limitations: Cohort phase attribution follows actual execution; mixed cohorts are not split artificially.

rows.measurement_window: earliest request arrival through simulation end, including initialization wait

measurement_windows.semantics: primary rates span earliest request arrival through simulation end; TTFT/E2E start at each request arrival; runtime rates exclude initialization

prefill.semantics: wall rate uses completed requests' input tokens once for prefill and committed non-prefill output tokens for decode; both use the primary request window. Busy rate includes scheduled/recomputed work; mixed batches overlap and busy rates are not additive

decode.semantics: wall rate uses completed requests' input tokens once for prefill and committed non-prefill output tokens for decode; both use the primary request window. Busy rate includes scheduled/recomputed work; mixed batches overlap and busy rates are not additive

memory_metrics.scope: operator NAND traffic (HBF/SSD); separately reported KV migration traffic is not implicitly included

active_service_lane_imbalance.semantics: busy-time imbalance among observed effective service lanes; not a physical-plane measurement and not all configured idle lanes

unavailable.physical_plane_imbalance: detailed physical-plane observations not enabled; effective lanes are distinct
unavailable.read_queue_depth: page-level queue occupancy timeline not recorded
unavailable.program_queue_depth: page-level queue occupancy timeline not recorded

memory_metrics.semantics: GB/s equals bytes/ns; logical/media ratios include RMW and merging and must not be called physical page fill fractions

migration_ledger.scope: physical KV pool transfers, separate from operator NAND traffic; explicit endpoints and completion times

prefetch.semantics: fraction of completed lookahead bytes consumed by resumed requests; not learned-router prediction accuracy

prefetch_overlap.scope: intersection with realized GPU operator stages of other requests; host setup and GPU frontend/controller stages excluded; operator envelopes may include memory stalls, not tensor-core busy time

rows.quantile_scope: empirical interpolation over reported sample count; no population tail-latency guarantee

address_assumptions.embedding: No token-ID trace is supplied. Analytical remote embedding row traffic uses a bounded cyclic address model when reads exceed the resident table; repeated traffic is retained and the allocation is not enlarged. This is not a measured token locality trace.

kv.prefetch_metric_semantics: useful bytes are completed copies exposed to a successful consumer cohort; unused bytes include reclaimed copies and completed copies not consumed; transfer time sums per-page latency and is not GPU stall time; opt-in lifecycle cancellation drains submitted physical phases, preserves their cost, then frees the destination; cancelled bytes are separate from completed/unused bytes
modeling_limits: offload_ratio bounds pressure-triggered migratable capacity; it is not a per-token mirror ratio
prefetch disabled when prefetch_distance=0
logical KV traffic counters are not added to resource-accounted bytes when attention kernels already include local memory traffic
KV read means external persisted-cache access only; prefill/recompute historical-prompt attention remains modeled as causal compute and ordinary attention/activation traffic

dram_traffic.accounting_semantics: resolved analytical burst bytes and controller waits; null means not fully recorded; empty organization_profiles is not evidence of complete geometry reporting; no device accuracy claim

limitations: Hardware is hypothetical: the base inventory is one GPU, 512 GiB HBM and 1 TiB HBF; 405B pairs explicitly expand HBM to 1 TiB. Unused capacity is retained in each comparison budget.

70B/1M retains its original 512 GiB HBM capacity controls including physical contiguous-allocation failures, and adds a separate A/B/D comparison with 1 TiB HBM for every architecture. The non-moving first-fit allocator may reject an extent despite enough total free bytes because free space is fragmented. This is not proof that the model's theoretical aggregate demand exceeds 512 GiB, nor that 1 TiB is the minimum hardware capacity. Rejections have no TPS and must not be paired against a successful run with different capacity.
C uses priority preemption, physical KV swap and resume, not an agent pause/resume API.
Named model architecture presets retain their true layers/weights; GPU compute remains an uncalibrated analytical model.
Contexts beyond each preset native limit are architecture extrapolation stress tests, without model quality claims.
E uses host DRAM over the declared PCIe/DDR path; G adds a local CXL-attached DRAM path. Neither is a rack-scale shared multi-GPU memory experiment.
F models cold KV on a hypothetical 7 GB/s read, 4 GB/s write NVMe tier with 50 us read and 800 us program; component hbf0 is replaced by kind=ssd for this baseline.
Migration accounting is reported independently from operator storage_traffic; it must not be interpreted as zero migration when storage task_count is zero.
Prefetch overlap uses realized GPU operator envelopes, not whole batches or host setup. Zero overlap remains a negative finding; no latency-hiding success is inferred from useful bytes alone.

Extended named-model pairs use the repository presets without fabricated missing models. Llama 405B pairs expand HBM to 1 TiB for both architectures; Qwen MoE presets retain their declared analytical approximation limitations.
Speculative decoding uses a synthetic explicit MTP branch and deterministic expected-prefix acceptance; probability parameters are not empirical model acceptance or quality measurements.

8B/70B 2K rows generate 32 output tokens; extended named-model 2K and long-context rows generate only four and are prefill-dominated. These finite traces do not establish production tail latency or stable service capacity.

path_contract.hbf_partition_scope: When mixed, HBF weights/KV own fixed equal capacity, bandwidth and effective-lane partitions; aggregate media inventory is unchanged across paths. Separate physical controllers; not dynamically shared NAND queues.
path_contract.budget_scope: Sum of distinct bidirectional path-link bandwidths; both directions share each resource. Common GPU-HBM and host-control links are unchanged and excluded.
path_contract.route_scope: KV swaps physically write then read relay memory. GPU HBF weight reads use the topology path as a direct remote-memory pipelined resource envelope, with no host staging copy.
path_contract.qos_scope: Static physical link partition between direct weights and relay KV; request priority preemption is explicit. No dynamic arbitration or packet-level QoS claim.

path_contract.hbf_partition_scope: When mixed, HBF weights/KV own fixed equal capacity, bandwidth and effective-lane partitions; aggregate media inventory is unchanged across paths. Separate physical controllers; not dynamically shared NAND queues.
path_contract.budget_scope: Sum of distinct bidirectional path-link bandwidths; both directions share each resource. Common GPU-HBM and host-control links are unchanged and excluded.
path_contract.route_scope: KV swaps physically write then read relay memory. GPU HBF weight reads use the topology path as a direct remote-memory pipelined resource envelope, with no host staging copy.
path_contract.qos_scope: Static physical link partition between direct weights and relay KV; request priority preemption is explicit. No dynamic arbitration or packet-level QoS claim.

qos_observations.scope: Two-request deterministic contention probe; per-request latency and configured SLO, not statistical fairness or sustainable capacity

capability.scope: real per-page NandCore execution plus finite-buffer pipelined ResourceTimeline link transfers; transport microbenchmark only

rows.measurement_scope: primary rate is total completed logical read bytes divided by time from arrival zero to final actual link completion, including startup, media latency, finite buffer backpressure and link latency. Link-stream rate starts at first link transmission and is a separate denominator.
rows.hardware_scope: Hypothetical 2048 physical array units and 2048 effective slots, explicit 12000 GB/s per internal channel, configured host port and separate transport link. This is sufficient-parallelism sensitivity, not a claim of realizable HBF geometry, pins or area.
rows.buffer_scope: Finite transport FIFO slots gate requests until link completion. The FIFO is capacity/backpressure state only; no additional DRAM read/write bandwidth is modeled.
rows.physical_page_scope: page_bytes controls actual NAND mapping, full-page read latency and read bytes; chunk_bytes is independently the link transport unit. 1.5 MiB physical pages are an attachment-requested hypothetical sensitivity, not vendor NAND specifications.

coverage.prior_physical_page_scan: 05 already contains hypothetical 1.5 MiB physical NAND pages; this group adds an independently fixed logical payload and transport chunk comparison.

limitations: Targets use decimal GB/s: 400/1600/3000 GB/s = 0.4/1.6/3.0 TB/s. A configured port value alone is not observed throughput.
This generously parallel synthetic inventory is not a feasibility, cost, area, packaging or real-silicon assertion.
All points execute 384 MiB of sequential reads in 1.5 MiB transport chunks with at most 64 finite FIFO slots. There is no GPU/token serving denominator.
Read-latency and physical-page scans retain the same authored geometry and port/link budget, so their actual parallelism bottlenecks remain visible.
1.5 MiB physical pages are explicitly hypothetical; this variable is separate from the unchanged 1.5 MiB transport chunk.
The link models serialized byte transfer and fixed propagation latency, without packet framing, retries, coherence or protocol calibration.
Finite FIFO backpressure is modeled; additional staging-memory service is outside this transport benchmark.

groups.title: ⑲ DRAM/NAND Core下的独立Decode对照

core_execution_audit.scope: successful Core submissions on the persistent online-serving kernel; excludes planner previews, isolated replay and pre-serving initialization
core_execution_audit.method: instrumented DramCore/NandCore submit and submit_many, selected by live PhysicalRuntimeContext identity
limitations: Cohort phase attribution follows actual execution; mixed cohorts are not split artificially.
Physical bytes are Core result counters; NAND internal/host transfer bytes are separate from media read/program bytes.
Instrumenting these process-global entry points requires one simulation thread per process.

rows.measurement_window: earliest request arrival through simulation end, including initialization wait

measurement_windows.semantics: primary rates span earliest request arrival through simulation end; TTFT/E2E start at each request arrival; runtime rates exclude initialization

prefill.semantics: wall rate uses completed requests' input tokens once for prefill and committed non-prefill output tokens for decode; both use the primary request window. Busy rate includes scheduled/recomputed work; mixed batches overlap and busy rates are not additive

decode.semantics: wall rate uses completed requests' input tokens once for prefill and committed non-prefill output tokens for decode; both use the primary request window. Busy rate includes scheduled/recomputed work; mixed batches overlap and busy rates are not additive

memory_metrics.scope: operator NAND traffic (HBF/SSD); separately reported KV migration traffic is not implicitly included

active_service_lane_imbalance.semantics: busy-time imbalance among observed effective service lanes; not a physical-plane measurement and not all configured idle lanes

unavailable.physical_plane_imbalance: detailed physical-plane observations not enabled; effective lanes are distinct
unavailable.read_queue_depth: page-level queue occupancy timeline not recorded
unavailable.program_queue_depth: page-level queue occupancy timeline not recorded

memory_metrics.semantics: GB/s equals bytes/ns; logical/media ratios include RMW and merging and must not be called physical page fill fractions

migration_ledger.scope: physical KV pool transfers, separate from operator NAND traffic; explicit endpoints and completion times

prefetch.semantics: fraction of completed lookahead bytes consumed by resumed requests; not learned-router prediction accuracy

prefetch_overlap.scope: intersection with realized GPU operator stages of other requests; host setup and GPU frontend/controller stages excluded; operator envelopes may include memory stalls, not tensor-core busy time

rows.quantile_scope: empirical interpolation over reported sample count; no population tail-latency guarantee

address_assumptions.embedding: No token-ID trace is supplied. Analytical remote embedding row traffic uses a bounded cyclic address model when reads exceed the resident table; repeated traffic is retained and the allocation is not enlarged. This is not a measured token locality trace.

kv.prefetch_metric_semantics: useful bytes are completed copies exposed to a successful consumer cohort; unused bytes include reclaimed copies and completed copies not consumed; transfer time sums per-page latency and is not GPU stall time; opt-in lifecycle cancellation drains submitted physical phases, preserves their cost, then frees the destination; cancelled bytes are separate from completed/unused bytes
modeling_limits: offload_ratio bounds pressure-triggered migratable capacity; it is not a per-token mirror ratio
prefetch disabled when prefetch_distance=0
logical KV traffic counters are not added to resource-accounted bytes when attention kernels already include local memory traffic
KV read means external persisted-cache access only; prefill/recompute historical-prompt attention remains modeled as causal compute and ordinary attention/activation traffic

audit_fixes: 修复迁移完成时刻重复累加、分块访问累加绝对时间、swap-in迁移漏计。
修复写缓冲自动排空漏计、介质编程早于主机确认、独立通道被串行化，以及未写入区域误命中缓冲。
修复迁移失败回滚、临时页预留破坏持久页、多页共享前缀释放，以及物理状态浅拷贝泄漏。
修复通用KV按模型最大上下文过度预留；连续物理KV采用与真实缓冲一致的准入预留，并报告请求/有效策略。
修复独立实验共用旧排队状态、把多步总时长当TPOT、未设置SLO仍生成合格吞吐。
修正文献配置中HBF-2/B200的HBM带宽、HBF+的SRAM总量、物理路径与服务路径参数不一致。
验收阶段状态由真实依赖检查计算；失败不会继续标记通过。论文参数化入口不再自行宣布整个计划完成。
主TPS/goodput改用最早请求到达至结束窗口，另列初始化后TPS、窗口起止及初始化等待。
修复实际batch达不到目标的问题；新增实际批量检查、1M压力点和缺失参数扫描。
异步预取保留源副本并预占目标，完成后才可消费；迁移目标容量峰值按实际占用更新。
远端NAND不再被要求绑定DRAM typed profile；NAND显式传输使用页对齐。
完整服务报告新增分向带宽、页访问/读写操作、迁移账本、阶段墙钟吞吐及所有延迟分位数。
前缀25%扫描改为20会话并区分请求/准入分母；能力声明随检查状态变化。
批量研究可跳过UI轨迹序列化；摘要、KV、存储及调度统计保持相同。
异步迁移按source/link/target阶段的真实就绪时刻提交，避免提前预订未来HBM写造成虚假的串行化。
长prompt的解析embedding读取允许重复访问既有权重表；采用明确标注的循环地址假设，不扩大驻留权重容量。
修复任务metadata重放使用过期对象标识引起的deepcopy缓存碰撞，避免长实验中的物理地址绑定污染。
多轮agent在同一服务时间线继承实际KV页；TTL过期重新计算，取消迁移保留已执行成本并等待安全释放。
补充完整服务的等效A/B消融、同链路预算direct/relay/dual及实际混合流优先级比较。
NAND动态热状态与显式擦除计数影响后续服务，记录真实物理页队列和包含空闲plane的负载失衡。
修复多GPU输出层集中到单GPU和服务汇总拒绝多GPU的问题；加入明确的多GPU共享内存暴露和端点路由约束。
预取提交字节按实际提交事件计数，取消操作不再错误地报告为零提交。
移除HBM按聚合带宽直接计时的旁路；算子访存和KV迁移均通过DRAM Core，GPU计算与启动仍保留原有简化模型。
完整服务逐点记录持久运行时实际DRAM/NAND提交；另跑固定64输出的独立Decode窗口，避免prefill稀释Decode影响。

units.cost_per_token: USD per million visible output tokens

limitations: These are conditional estimates, not calibrated HBF costs, guaranteed lifespan or a commercial optimum.
Cost/area scans hold TPS fixed and do not re-execute serving; no benefit in TPS, goodput or session capacity follows from these rows.
Cost includes stated purchase prices only. Wear replacement costs are reported separately; labor, financing, tax, downtime and service fees are excluded.
Uniform-wear lifetime excludes stateful FTL, retention and nonuniform wear.

checklist_progress.reason: TPS/goodput共同请求窗口；初始化后TPS、TTFT/TPOT/TBT/E2E四分位数和样本数、分向带宽均保留。
按实际max_observed_batch_requests判断，不按场景名称计数。
超过模型原生上下文的结果只作架构压力外推，不作语义准确率声明。
实际算子执行与物理放置检查见第9组；第13组另运行真正的多轮agent生命周期。
明确内部假设；第14组另将磨损直接反馈到服务时间线。

figure_manifest.global_caption_zh: 图表来自实际运行的仿真：完整算子服务与物理读带宽微基准分别标记，不是实测硬件性能。微基准不作为LLM TPS；有限SLO实验不解释为无限期稳定性证明。

figures.title_zh: 小模型实际 batch：TPS 与 goodput
figures.caption_zh: 只取固定硬件的小模型 2K 完整服务点，排除带宽扫描及微基准。横轴取实际最大 batch；TPS/goodput 均按包含初始化等待的请求观测窗口计算。短输出与有限轨迹不代表稳态服务能力。

figures.title_zh: 命名模型上下文：TPS 与 B/A 比率
figures.caption_zh: 仅使用完整命名模型 A/B 配对；不是内存微基准。2K 点为 32 输出，长上下文点仅 4 输出，不能把折线斜率解释为纯上下文效应。70B/1M共同扩为1TiB HBM，原512GiB容量对照不参与配对。128K加输出与1M超出原生上下文，采用星号及空心菱形标记。比值仅匹配相同输出长度和硬件清单。

figures.title_zh: SLO 原始点：到达间隔、实际 batch 与延迟
figures.caption_zh: 到达间隔和实际 batch 均保留原始可行/不可行点，不拟合、不插值稳态边界。到达间隔轴只标注 0/10/100/1000 微秒主刻度，所有细化散点仍保留，细化值见报告和 manifest 原始记录。p99 是各有限请求/TBT 样本的经验分位数；请求样本量随 batch 改变。水平 SLO 线仅为配置阈值，不能解释为估计服务容量。

figures.title_zh: 预取对照：GPU 算子重叠与 TPS
figures.caption_zh: C 热冷 KV 策略，按同一场景 distance=0 对照比较 TPS。重叠取真实 GPU invocation 算子阶段与预取复制区间的交集，排除主机设置和批次空白包络；算子阶段仍可能包含内存等待，不等于 tensor-core 忙碌时间。decode 为全部算子重叠的子集，不能相加。

figures.title_zh: 多GPU共享池：实际节点与每GPU吞吐
figures.caption_zh: 小模型A/B/D/G与8B命名模型A/B固定共享池，显式1/2/4 GPU执行；红叉为机架网络变体。多GPU没有直接按单GPU吞吐倍乘。
负载搜索使用三个轨迹长度核验。并发边界与到达率边界采用不同的明确工作负载，不混为统一生产容量。

figures.title_zh: 端口与有效带宽：含链路瓶颈负对照
figures.caption_zh: 物理内存读取与真实链路占用后计算端到端有效带宽；计入启动、延迟与有限缓冲反压。
figures.row_scope: physical sequential-read and link microbenchmark; no LLM TPS

figures.title_zh: 固定输出下的独立Decode TPS、TPOT及A/B倍率
figures.caption_zh: 统一64输出，真实prefill后测量63个Decode token。HBM与HBF均执行对应物理Core；GPU计算和启动继续采用原有简化模型。
